item.content:encoded: Sealed bids shall be received, opened, and publicly read aloud by the Buffalo Sewer Authority at its offices, 1038 City Hall, Buffalo, New York 14202, at 11:00 AM EST, on Thursday, July 9, 2026 , for the “Colorado Avenue – CSO053 SPP 337 Modification” . A virtual Pre-Bid meeting will be held on Tuesday, June 16, 2026, at 11:00 AM EST via Microsoft Teams to discuss the project scope, NYSEFC funding requirements, and to answer initial questions. For an MS Teams invitation to the Pre-Bid meeting, please contact Angela Hintz at ahintz@jmdavidsoneng.com. All questions should be placed in writing and directed to the Engineer, Angela Hintz at ahintz@jmdavidsoneng.com .

item.content:encoded: BUFFALO SEWER AUTHORITY INVITATION TO BID Sealed bids for the following will be received, opened, and public­ly read aloud by the Buffalo Sew-er Authority at its Purchasing Office, Wastewater Treatment Plant, Sewer Maintenance Bldg., Ft. of W. Ferry St., Buffalo, New York 14213, 716-851-4664: *PURCHASE OF GAS DETEC­TION SYSTEM FOR THICKENER BUILDING at 10:00 A.M. local time on DECEMBER 17, 2025 Specifications are available digitally by request to jrine@ buffalosewer.org or at the above stated address Monday – Friday 7:30 am – 3:00 pm (excluding holidays). All questions or requests for information generated following review of the proposal package must be submitted in writing to the Authority’s Purchase Office no later than DECEMBER 12, 2025.
